Name: Haley's Coming Out - REMASTERED
Author: kettuluv
Description:
[color=#00ff00][size=5][u][b]What is in this mod?[/b][/u][/size][/color]
[size=3]This is a remastered, slowed down version of my old Haley's Coming Out mod. This mod is a year 1/some of year 2 story mod about Haley's discovery that she is actually a lesbian! This mod is most certainly NOT aimed towards male players, as none of the dialogue or events will make sense if you choose a male farmer.
This mod has edited nearly every one of Haley's dialogue lines to tell a story, along with some lines from Emily and Alex during certain times[/size],[color=#00ff00] [/color][size=3][color=#00ff00][u]over 200+ lines total[/u][/color][u] [/u]have been edited and added. It also adds[/size][color=#00ff00][u] [size=3]4  new events[/size][/u][/color][size=2] [/size][size=3](one of which has a toggle due to a sexual conversation) in addition to the vanilla events, and [color=#00ff00][u]overwrites 1 vanilla event[/u] [/color]with my version, a version that matches more with my story.
This mod edits Haley's marriage dialogue to be more story accurate, so you can absolutely leave this mod in even after the story ends around Spring or Summer Y2!

It's important to mention that [b][color=#00ff00][u]nothing is locked by date[/u][/color],[/b] and this mod's event preconditions are much looser and also [b][color=#00ff00][u]not locked by date[/u][/color][/b], so you shouldn't miss anything if, say, the green rain happens in summer. Oops.
[color=#dd7e6b]
[/color][/size][size=5][b][color=#00ff00][u]How do I play this mod?[/u][/color][/b]
[/size][size=3]It's easy! You [u]will[/u] have to start a new save, as the beginning of the story starts basically right away. I highly encourage talking to Haley, Alex, and Emily every day, along with regular gifts to achieve proper heart levels.[/size][size=3][b][color=#00ff00][u]Here are my recommendations to see most dialogue:[/u][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][i][u]0-2 hearts[/u] with Haley and Alex, and Emily in Spring year 1[/i]
[*][i][u]2-4 hearts[/u] with Haley, Alex, and Emily in Summer year 1[/i]
[*][i][u]4-6 hearts[/u] with Haley in Fall year 1[/i]
[*][i][u]6-8 hearts[/u] Haley and Emily in Winter year 1[/i]
[*][i][u]8-10 hearts[/u] with Haley in Spring year 2[/i]
[*][i][u]10 hearts[/u] with Haley in Summer year 2[/i]
[/list]
[b][color=#00ff00]Keep these important notes in mind to make the story make sense[/color]:[/b]
[list]
[*]Haley will assume you are dating after the Feast of the Winter Star.
[*]Haley will assume you will propose around mid-summer Y2 or so.
[/list][color=#f1f1f1]These are just guidelines. If you don't ask Haley out after Feast of the Winter Star, she will default back to her original dialogue. You will not see mine until you start dating her.[/color]
In addition, if you want to see the First Time Event, please keep the farmhouse only on the first upgrade until after you see the Event. If you upgrade past the kitchen and double bed, the optional Event mentioned above WILL mess up!! If you want to toggle this off, then you're safe to upgrade your house past this point.

[/size][color=#00ff00][size=4][u]And that's about it! But, there are some things I couldn't quite work out...[/u][/size][/color]
[list]
[*][size=3]for some reason, some of Haley's old dialogue comes through during marriage. I scoured all the dialogue and could not find where it came from, but I think it still fits.[/size]
[/list][list]
[/list]

[size=5][b][color=#00ff00]Anyway, that's all! Please enjoy the story! :D[/color][/b]
[/size]
